title: agrostis canina var. coarctata
intro: Agrostis canina var. coarctata, commonly known as a variety of bentgrass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as a diuretic and to help lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis canina var. coarctata include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
